items_all.title: Anthropic CEO Amodei wants AI speed limits before self-improvement outpaces human control
items_all.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei is calling for a controlled slowdown in AI development. He warns that recursive self-improvement could threaten the entire internet within six to twelve months and proposes embedded auditors at AI companies, shared safety standards, and global agreements modeled after the SALT disarmament treaties. His warning comes just ahead of what could be the largest initial public offering in history. The article Anthropic CEO Amodei wants AI speed limits before self-improvement outpaces human control appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic 執行長 Dario Amodei 呼籲對人工智慧發展進行受控的放緩。他警告說，遞迴自我改進可能會在六到十二個月內危險地威脅整個網際網路，並提出了在人工智慧公司中派駐稽核員、共享安全標準以及仿效 SALT 裁軍條約的全球協議。他的警告正值可能成為歷史上最大規模首次公開募股之前夕。這篇題為 Anthropic 執行長 Amodei 希望在自我改進超越人類控制之前設定人工智慧速限的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: GPT-6 Astra appears to show a "step change" in spatial reasoning based on early benchmarks
items_all.summary: In a new robotics benchmark, GPT-6 Astra shows major gains in spatial understanding. On StationeryBench, the model completed 7 out of 100 tasks with dual-arm robots, while competitor MolmoAct2 couldn't finish a single one. A researcher calls it a "step change in spatial reasoning." The article GPT-6 Astra appears to show a "step change" in spatial reasoning based on early benchmarks appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all.title: AI models' written reasoning steps correspond to distinct internal patterns, a new study finds
items_all.summary: Reasoning steps like calculation, formula retrieval, and deduction are clearly separable in a model's internal states, especially in the middle layers. That matters for AI safety, because models process more than their visible chain of thought reveals. The article AI models' written reasoning steps correspond to distinct internal patterns, a new study finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 在一項新研究中發現，模型的內部狀態中，諸如計算、公式檢索和推導等推理步驟是可明確區分的，特別是在中間層。這對AI安全性很重要，因為模型處理的內容比其表面上的思考鏈所顯示的還要多。這篇名為「AI模型的書面推理步驟對應到不同的內部模式」的文章最早出現於The Decoder。

items_all.title: GPT-6 Astra needs leaner prompts and fewer guardrails, OpenAI recommends
items_all.summary: Overly long skill descriptions, blanket reading requirements, and rigid approval rules can get in GPT-6 Astra's way, warns OpenAI's Eric Provencher. More capable models need less hand-holding, so developers should tie instructions to specific tasks and spell out when the job is done. The article GPT-6 Astra needs leaner prompts and fewer guardrails, OpenAI recommends appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: GPT-6 Astra 的專案負責人 Eric Provencher 警告說，過長的技能描述、全面的閱讀要求以及僵化的審批規則可能會妨礙 OpenAI's 的發展。能力更強的模型需要更少的從旁協助，因此開發人員應將指令與特定任務綁定，並明確指出何時工作已經完成。這篇題為 GPT-6 Astra 需要更精簡的提示詞和更少的護欄 OpenAI 的文章最初發表在 The Decoder 上。

items_all.title: Google's new AI model predicts the future from sales data, weather, and discount schedules
items_all.summary: Google Research has released TimesFM-3, a forecasting model that analyzes time series alongside related data and known future events like sales promotions or weather forecasts. Instead of predicting the future step by step, the 330-million-parameter model fills in all future time points in a single pass, which cuts compute time and reduces compounding errors. The article Google's new AI model predicts the future from sales data, weather, and discount schedules appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Google Research 推出了 TimesFM-3，這是一個能分析時間序列以及相關數據和已知未來事件（例如促銷活動或氣象預報）的預測模型。這個擁有 3.3 億個參數的模型不是逐步預測未來，而是一次過填滿所有未來的時間點，從而縮短計算時間並減少累積誤差。文章 Google's new AI model predicts the future from sales data, weather, and discount schedules 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Leading mathematicians fear AI is making their field dumber, and warn the rest of us is next
items_all.summary: In a joint statement, 25 Fields Medal winners warn that the goals of the AI industry and mathematics are "severely misaligned." They argue that mass-producing solved problems with AI undermines the discipline's true goal: understanding. The mathematicians see this as a symptom of a broader threat to intellectual work. The article Leading mathematicians fear AI is making their field dumber, and warn the rest of us is next appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 在一份聯合聲明中，25 位費爾茲獎得主警告稱，人工智慧產業的目標與數學「嚴重錯位」。他們主張，用人工智慧大量生產已解決的問題，會破壞該學科真正的目標：理解。數學家們將此視為對智力工作更廣泛威脅的徵兆。這篇題為《頂尖數學家擔心 AI 正在讓他們的領域變笨，並警告我們其他人將是下一個》（Leading mathematicians fear AI is making their field dumber, and warn the rest of us is next）的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Generating running routes with GPT-6 Astra and ChatGPT Work
items_all.summary: Here's a neat thing I had ChatGPT Work with GPT-6 Astra (Max) do this morning: I live at <my address>. Figure out 5K and 10K running routes from me that loop from my house. Use OSM data. It worked for 27 minutes and produced exactly what I'd asked for, as both an embedded visualization and downloadable GPX file and GeoJSON files. Here's that 5K route: When I asked it how it had created the route, it replied: I used Nominatim to locate the address and Overpass to download local OpenStreetMap roads and trails , then calculated the loops locally. Frustratingly, the actual code it ran and exact details of what it did weren't visible to me in the ChatGPT UI. I see this lack of transparency is an anti-feature. By the time I thought to ask for a copy of the Python code it had used, ChatGPT was unable to provide it. This appears to be because the thread had been compacted. I think any LLM system that uses compaction needs to both preserve the pre-compacted text and make that text available via agent tool calls, to protect against this kind of problem. As for displaying the map to me, that used the visualize skill . It created a file called /workspace/el-granada-5k-share.html to embed directly into the ChatGPT UI. Here's a copy of that HTML , which starts like this: < div id =" eg-share-loop " > < div class =" viz-row " > < h3 > El Granada harbor loop </ h3 > < span class =" text-small " > 5.1 km </ span > </ div > < div id =" eg-share-stage " > </ div > < div class =" text-small text-muted " > Map data © < a href =" https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright " target =" _blank " rel =
items_all.summary_zh: 以下是我今天早上讓 ChatGPT 搭配 GPT-6 Astra (Max) 做的一件酷事：我住在 <my address>。請幫我規劃從我家出發並繞回臺的 5 公里與 10 公里跑步路線。使用 OSM 資料。它運作了 27 分鐘，精準產出了我要求的成果，同時提供了嵌入式視覺化畫面以及可下載的 GPX 與 GeoJSON 檔案。這是那個 5 公里路線：當我詢問它是如何建立這條路線時，它回答：我使用 Nominatim 來定位地址，並使用 Overpass 來下載當地的 OpenStreetMap 道路與小徑，然後在本地計算迴圈路線。令人沮喪的是，它實際執行的程式碼以及所做所為的確切細節，在 ChatGPT 的使用者介面中對我而言是不可見的。我認為這種缺乏透明度的設計是一個反功能（anti-feature）。等到我想到要索取它所使用的 Python 程式碼副本時，ChatGPT 已經無法提供。這似乎是因為執行緒（thread）已經被壓縮（compacted）了。我認為任何使用壓縮機制的 LLM 系統，都需要同時保留壓縮前的文字，並透過代理程式工具呼叫（agent tool calls）提供這些文字，以防範這類問題。至於向我顯示地圖的部分，則是使用了視覺化技能。它建立了一個名為 /workspace/el-granada-5k-share.html 的檔案，直接嵌入到 ChatGPT 的使用者介面中。以下是該 HTML 的副本，開頭如下：< div id =" eg-share-loop " > < div class =" viz-row " > < h3 > El Granada harbor loop </ h3 > < span class =" text-small " > 5.1 km </ span > </ div > < div id =" eg-share-stage " > </ div > < div class =" text-small text-muted " > Map data © < a href =" https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright " target =" _blank " rel =

items_all.summary: For a while, I must admit, it looked as if software developer roles like mine were done for. How could we fight against tireless robots? A.I. can write very good software, but it also makes it easy to do someone else’s job badly, which is part of why all those projects fail. items_all_raw.title: Generating running routes with GPT-6 Astra and ChatGPT Work
items_all_raw.summary: Here's a neat thing I had ChatGPT Work with GPT-6 Astra (Max) do this morning: I live at <my address>. Figure out 5K and 10K running routes from me that loop from my house. Use OSM data. It worked for 27 minutes and produced exactly what I'd asked for, as both an embedded visualization and downloadable GPX file and GeoJSON files. Here's that 5K route: When I asked it how it had created the route, it replied: I used Nominatim to locate the address and Overpass to download local OpenStreetMap roads and trails , then calculated the loops locally. Frustratingly, the actual code it ran and exact details of what it did weren't visible to me in the ChatGPT UI. I see this lack of transparency is an anti-feature. By the time I thought to ask for a copy of the Python code it had used, ChatGPT was unable to provide it. This appears to be because the thread had been compacted. I think any LLM system that uses compaction needs to both preserve the pre-compacted text and make that text available via agent tool calls, to protect against this kind of problem. As for displaying the map to me, that used the visualize skill . It created a file called /workspace/el-granada-5k-share.html to embed directly into the ChatGPT UI. Here's a copy of that HTML , which starts like this: < div id =" eg-share-loop " > < div class =" viz-row " > < h3 > El Granada harbor loop </ h3 > < span class =" text-small " > 5.1 km </ span > </ div > < div id =" eg-share-stage " > </ div > < div class =" text-small text-muted " > Map data © < a href =" https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright " target =" _blank " rel =
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 以下是我今天早上讓 ChatGPT 搭配 GPT-6 Astra (Max) 做的一件酷事：我住在 <my address>。請幫我規劃從我家出發並繞回臺的 5 公里與 10 公里跑步路線。使用 OSM 資料。它運作了 27 分鐘，精準產出了我要求的成果，同時提供了嵌入式視覺化畫面以及可下載的 GPX 與 GeoJSON 檔案。這是那個 5 公里路線：當我詢問它是如何建立這條路線時，它回答：我使用 Nominatim 來定位地址，並使用 Overpass 來下載當地的 OpenStreetMap 道路與小徑，然後在本地計算迴圈路線。令人沮喪的是，它實際執行的程式碼以及所做所為的確切細節，在 ChatGPT 的使用者介面中對我而言是不可見的。我認為這種缺乏透明度的設計是一個反功能（anti-feature）。等到我想到要索取它所使用的 Python 程式碼副本時，ChatGPT 已經無法提供。這似乎是因為執行緒（thread）已經被壓縮（compacted）了。我認為任何使用壓縮機制的 LLM 系統，都需要同時保留壓縮前的文字，並透過代理程式工具呼叫（agent tool calls）提供這些文字，以防範這類問題。至於向我顯示地圖的部分，則是使用了視覺化技能。它建立了一個名為 /workspace/el-granada-5k-share.html 的檔案，直接嵌入到 ChatGPT 的使用者介面中。以下是該 HTML 的副本，開頭如下：< div id =" eg-share-loop " > < div class =" viz-row " > < h3 > El Granada harbor loop </ h3 > < span class =" text-small " > 5.1 km </ span > </ div > < div id =" eg-share-stage " > </ div > < div class =" text-small text-muted " > Map data © < a href =" https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright " target =" _blank " rel =

items_all_raw.title: Fly Language Model (FLM) Wires the Full Fruit Fly Connectome Into a Frozen 1.2B LLM, and Its Own Controls Show the Wiring Does Not Help
items_all_raw.summary: The Fly Language Model (FLM) drives all 166,700 retained neurons and 25.6 million edges of the MaleCNS fruit fly connectome with token embeddings, then adds a small learned correction to a frozen LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct backbone. Only 278,528 parameters train. The accompanying preprint reports a 0.0222 nat per token improvement over the backbone, but a parameter-matched control without the graph does slightly better in every seed. We break down the architecture, the four controls, the 0.6 per token memory bound, and what it takes to run the MIT-licensed code locally. The post Fly Language Model (FLM) Wires the Full Fruit Fly Connectome Into a Frozen 1.2B LLM, and Its Own Controls Show the Wiring Does Not Help appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 果蠅語言模型（FLM）利用標記嵌入（token embeddings）驅動雄性中樞神經系統（MaleCNS）果蠅連線組的所有 166,700 個保留神經元與 2,560 萬個邊，然後對凍結的 LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct 骨幹網路加入一個小型學習修正。僅訓練 278,528 個參數。隨附的預印本報告指出，相較於骨幹網路，每個標記（token）提升了 0.0222 nat 的效能，但在每個隨機種子中，未包含圖形且參數匹配的對照組表現皆略勝一籌。我們深入剖析其架構、四種對照組、每個標記 0.6 的記憶體限制，以及在本地端執行此 MIT 授權程式碼所需的事項。這篇文章「Fly Language Model (FLM) Wires the Full Fruit Fly Connectome Into a Frozen 1.2B LLM, and Its Own Controls Show the Wiring Does Not Help」最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

That matters for AI safety, because models process more than their visible chain of thought reveals. The article AI models' written reasoning steps correspond to distinct internal patterns, a new study finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 在一項新研究中發現，模型的內部狀態中，諸如計算、公式檢索和推導等推理步驟是可明確區分的，特別是在中間層。這對AI安全性很重要，因為模型處理的內容比其表面上的思考鏈所顯示的還要多。這篇名為「AI模型的書面推理步驟對應到不同的內部模式」的文章最早出現於The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Google's new AI model predicts the future from sales data, weather, and discount schedules
items_all_raw.summary: Google Research has released TimesFM-3, a forecasting model that analyzes time series alongside related data and known future events like sales promotions or weather forecasts. Instead of predicting the future step by step, the 330-million-parameter model fills in all future time points in a single pass, which cuts compute time and reduces compounding errors. The article Google's new AI model predicts the future from sales data, weather, and discount schedules appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Google Research 推出了 TimesFM-3，這是一個能分析時間序列以及相關數據和已知未來事件（例如促銷活動或氣象預報）的預測模型。這個擁有 3.3 億個參數的模型不是逐步預測未來，而是一次過填滿所有未來的時間點，從而縮短計算時間並減少累積誤差。文章 Google's new AI model predicts the future from sales data, weather, and discount schedules 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Leading mathematicians fear AI is making their field dumber, and warn the rest of us is next
items_all_raw.summary: In a joint statement, 25 Fields Medal winners warn that the goals of the AI industry and mathematics are "severely misaligned." They argue that mass-producing solved problems with AI undermines the discipline's true goal: understanding. The mathematicians see this as a symptom of a broader threat to intellectual work. The article Leading mathematicians fear AI is making their field dumber, and warn the rest of us is next appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 在一份聯合聲明中，25 位費爾茲獎得主警告稱，人工智慧產業的目標與數學「嚴重錯位」。他們主張，用人工智慧大量生產已解決的問題，會破壞該學科真正的目標：理解。數學家們將此視為對智力工作更廣泛威脅的徵兆。這篇題為《頂尖數學家擔心 AI 正在讓他們的領域變笨，並警告我們其他人將是下一個》（Leading mathematicians fear AI is making their field dumber, and warn the rest of us is next）的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。
